Each carries the literal instruction for the moment it is done. `check` lets the desk read done from the tree; TASKS.db.json (synced from the served page's store) carries what Mike ticked; `done: true` here is Ops' hand. Edited by Ops; rendered by tools/days.mjs into docs/desk/DAYS.html.

tasks.title: Sitting: the catalogue's pitches
do: Thirty minutes, Sunday, with the served page Code sends that morning.

Every feature, game, setting, character and artifact, one line each. You read the page and answer the numbered A/B/C questions in chat; anything you do not like, say so in one line and it is rewritten.
Nothing is due from you before the page arrives.

tasks.title: Sitting: the five wing mocks
do: Thirty minutes, Sunday, with the served page Code sends that morning.
The feature page, the day's landing, the prologue, a character page, the wing's front. Served pages; A/B/C in chat.
Nothing is due from you before the page arrives.

tasks.title: Sitting: the room and the framing
do: Thirty minutes, Sunday, with the served page Code sends that morning.
Three practice reels side by side on a page; you pick the room, the framing and the mic that stay fixed from then on.
Nothing is due from you before the page arrives.

tasks.title: Sitting: song two

tasks.title: Buffer: the six clicks
do: Instagram to a Creator account. TikTok a Creator account, public. A Facebook Page.
buffer.com: sign up with email; connect TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, the Facebook Page; Essentials plan.
Settings › API › create a key. Paste it here or save it as C:\AI\PERSONA-20260903\.secrets\buffer.token.
The whole list with the exact taps is BUFFER-SETUP.md in the persona folder.

tasks.title: Distributor account
do: Create the account at the distributor Code names that week (DistroKid unless ruled otherwise), with your email. No release is created; the account only has to exist so the first live single can go up within days.
Tell Code: "distributor done".

tasks.title: Google: read-only consent for YouTube
do: Code sends one link that morning. It opens Google's consent screen for read-only access to the channel's comments and analytics. Approve, done.
Nothing is uploaded through it; it only reads.
